section_summary.extract_value: This section reports a single sample (no explicit study numbering) of 191 women and 154 men (total N = 345) from mainland China who were working or studying at a university in Hong Kong. Participants ranged in age from 16 to 47 (M = 22.41, SD = 5.30) and had self-reported BMI from 16.02 to 35.69 (M = 21.00, SD = 2.93).
